properties.html:
When Government of Ahmedabad wanted to start its first metro rail service in the state capital, they hugely advertised and offered lucrative offers to attract repeat customers. So, if a customer purchased tickets for 4 consecutive days, he would be eligible for a 20% discount on every ticket he purchases from that day onwards. Further if a customer buys ticket for 5 consecutive days, he will be eligible for a 25% discount on every ticket from that day onwards. Similarly, 30% discount is given to the customer who travels for 6 consecutive days and 40% discount for the customer travelling 7 consecutive days. The maximum discount a customer can receive is 40%. The following chart provides the information about the number of tickets sold for first 8 days.

Further it is noted that 60% of the first-time commuters on a day, travelled again on the next day. Also 30% of the first-time commuters, brought the ticket for the third time on 3rd consecutive day. Similarly 15% of the first time commuters, brought ticket for 4 consecutive days, 10% of the first time commuters, visited for 5 consecutive days and only 5% of the first time commuters brought tickets for 6 consecutive days. No commuter travelled for 7 consecutive days. Also, the commuters brought ticket again only on consecutive days.

How many commuters brought the ticket for the first time on the 6th day?
